Synopsis:
Barcus has agreed to rest in your camp. This will be his base of operations for looking for Wulbren.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_UnfortunateGnome.json: Barcus has accepted your invitation to use the camp as his base while he plans to rescue his friend Wulbren, who was taken to Moonrise Towers (there are hints the captors may be duergar). Off‑screen events include Wulbren's prior capture and Barcus's own failed or bungled attempts, which leave him doubting his competence as an adventurer and worried he might be recaptured. From camp he frets and asks your opinion, then reluctantly begs you to look for Wulbren because he feels he’d be more harm than help. The player can agree to take on the rescue.
- UND_UnfortunateGnome.json: If you saved Barcus from the windmill, you can meet him again in the underdark. He's been captured once again - this time by a band of duergar (who follow the Absolute, same as the goblins did previously). If you get rid of his captors, you can talk to him some more about his next steps. He's still keen on saving his friend, Wulbren.
- WYR_MeetingMizora.json: Dialog with mizora at Wyrm's Rock near the entrance to Lower city. You see Ravengard taken away, and Mizora tells you to meet him in camp. Version if Wyll is not there.
- Wyll_InParty2_Nested_FreedMizora.json: Default dialogue when speaking to Wyll during exploration.
- Wyll_InParty2.json: Default dialogue when speaking to Wyll during exploration.
